driver_archetypes.rationale: Compliant car baseline. High tau (2.5s) and low accel/decel ensure cars stop at red to match M2/early/car (~0) and M3/share/car (~0). Discharge headway is tuned via traffic density/IDM parameters.
Car violators (custom2) drawn from 'car' distribution. Params identical to car_saval to maintain low red-running and early-start behavior for the car population.

Compliant motorcycle baseline. Reduced share (0.6) to allow 'moto_seeker' to capture the observed wrong-lane and early-start metrics. minGap=1.9m is wide to prevent overshoot in this archetype, relying on rule-triggered behavior for M4/overshoot.

Motorcycle violators drawing from 'moto' distribution. Increased share (0.4) to boost wrong-lane usage probability (M8/moto target ~0.21). Identical physical params to moto_saval but enabled for queue_space_seeking rules.

Illegal left-turning motorcycles (distribution moto_violator). Share 1.0 ensures 'moto_violator' sums to exactly 1.0. jmTimegapMinor=1.0s is the default lever for box-waiting duration; physical behavior same as compliant motos.

traci_rules.rationale: Matches Saval et al. 2023 (front-row motorcycle red-running probability ~0.5). k=0 removes swarm effect. p_max caps probability. Note: This rule contributes to M3/share/moto, but with high early_start usage, the combined metric will be tuned.
Targets M2/early/moto (observed share 0.1303). p=0.13 approximates the probability of creeping over the stop line in the last 5s of red. t_before_green=5s matches the observation window.

Targets M8/moto wrong-lane share (obs 0.2131) and M9a (queue blocking). q=35m triggers seeking at moderate queues. t_g_s=7s estimates green clearance. p_wrong_lane=0.25 sets a higher probability to match the observed lateral encroachment, compensating for the specific trigger conditions of the proxy net.
Field observation: most motorcycles pass a standing U-turner; p=0.8 (80% probability) and t_wait=2s reflects quick lateral filtering.
Field observation: cars rarely bypass U-turners; p=0.1 (10% probability) matches conservative car behaviour.
